item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":50,"end_unit":50,"fact_summary":"An Alexandria administrative court rescinded a decision closing a marble workshop employing persons with disabilities and urged lawmakers to adopt a disability act.","question_ids":["3B.4","6B.8","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical institutional finding; predates 2023 but remained part of the legal framework relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The document attributes the action to an administrative court and lawmakers, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["No evidence here of the President's personal direction or of implementation after the ruling."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":50,"end_unit":50,"fact_summary":"Administrative courts ordered the Ministry of Social Solidarity to increase assistance for a woman with an intellectual disability, increase a disabled girl's stipend, and require health insurance to provide prescribed medication to a girl with autism.","question_ids":["3B.4","6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical court-enforcement examples; no 2023 outcome is stated.","ruler_attribution":"The document attributes these remedies to administrative courts and ministries, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not quantify broader compliance or service coverage."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":51,"end_unit":51,"fact_summary":"Nine persons with disabilities served in the current House of Representatives; seven were women, eight were elected, and one was appointed. A parliamentary committee on solidarity, family and persons with disabilities was created, with a female representative with a motor disability appointed as undersecretary.","question_ids":["4B.7","6B.3","8B.4","8B.5"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional representation described as current in the source, but not specifically dated to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source reports parliamentary composition and appointments without attributing them directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The document does not establish the committee's independent influence or policy results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":51,"end_unit":51,"fact_summary":"Egypt's Ministry of Housing adopted an accessibility code for buildings, and national strategies addressed protection and social, health and legislative inclusion of children and persons with disabilities through 2030.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.3","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Long-term policies and strategies extending into 2030; implementation status in 2023 is not established.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes these measures to ministries and councils; presidential authorship is not specified.","limitations":["The evidence concerns formal policy and stated coordination more than measured outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":51,"end_unit":52,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Social Solidarity coordinated with the Ministry of Planning on a disability strategy within Egypt Vision 2030; it held 16 consultative workshops across 27 governorates with about 525 participants and representatives of 90 civil-society organizations.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.4","6B.5","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Long-term planning and consultation evidence; no 2023 implementation result is provided.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes coordination and consultations to ministries and civil-society participants, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["Consultation participation does not by itself demonstrate effective or equitable service delivery."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":52,"end_unit":52,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Justice prepared a draft law establishing a commission on equality and prevention of discrimination; adoption procedures and community dialogues were ongoing.","question_ids":["4B.7","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Draft-law status is historical; completion by 2023 is not shown.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the draft to the Ministry of Justice, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The measure had not yet been adopted according to the cited passage."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":52,"end_unit":54,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported constitutional, statutory and judicial protections for women and persons with disabilities, including equal political rights, representation provisions, social-insurance entitlements, education and employment protections, and court decisions enforcing custody, medication, benefits and continued employment.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Legal and judicial framework predates 2023; the source does not establish 2023 outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The source presents state law and court enforcement; it does not show direct presidential intervention.","limitations":["Some cited judicial reasoning contains gender-stereotyped language, and the source does not assess enforcement consistency."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":55,"end_unit":56,"fact_summary":"Women were allocated one quarter of local-council seats, and the National Council for Persons with Disabilities was established to integrate and empower persons with disabilities; women with disabilities held council leadership roles.","question_ids":["4B.7","6B.3","6B.9","8B.4"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional arrangements described as established before or during the reporting period; 2023 effects are not measured.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes these arrangements to state institutions and legislation, without isolating el-Sisi's role.","limitations":["No evidence is supplied about actual local-council elections, influence or accountability."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":56,"end_unit":58,"fact_summary":"Government bodies reported community centres, media participation, disability strategies, child-protection mechanisms, a national child strategy for 2018–2030, a national hotline and free access to health, educational and social rights for children with disabilities.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Programmes and strategies span years before 2023 and into 2030; current effectiveness is not independently evaluated.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes implementation to ministries and councils, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The document largely reports government measures and does not provide independent outcome verification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":58,"end_unit":59,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported health and education access measures for children with disabilities, including insurance coverage for children under six, rehabilitation services for uninsured children, gradual newborn screening across governorates, vaccination campaigns, integration directives, 130 tablets distributed and language services for 245 children with hearing disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported programme results are historical and not specifically measured for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes these outputs to ministries and authorities, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["Coverage, quality and distributional effects beyond the listed figures are not established."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":60,"end_unit":61,"fact_summary":"The Public Prosecutor and Ministry of Justice reported child-protection complaint, inspection and legal-enforcement mechanisms, while the government reported media, sign-language and accessibility measures for persons with disabilities.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","3B.8","6B.5","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical institutional measures; no 2023 enforcement statistics are supplied.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the measures to prosecutorial, judicial and executive institutions, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The account is largely self-reported and does not quantify complaints resolved or violations remedied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":62,"end_unit":64,"fact_summary":"The government reported disability-accessible public services, 31 inclusive community centres serving 112 informal settlements in Cairo and three centres in South Sinai, 70 planned service offices, accessible parliamentary facilities and an initiative to establish a National Academy of Information Technology for Persons with Disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Projects and institutional measures largely predate 2023; durability and 2023 results are not demonstrated.","ruler_attribution":"The source identifies ministries and the President as responsible for some initiatives, including the academy, but does not establish personal presidential oversight beyond launch.","limitations":["Planned offices and reported facilities do not establish full implementation or service quality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":64,"end_unit":65,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported disability-accessibility standards for public buildings, accessibility modifications to the House of Representatives, and 22 court buildings newly built, rebuilt or renovated to comply with the accessibility code.","question_ids":["4B.4","6B.2","6B.8","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Infrastructure and legal-access measures reported from earlier years; no 2023 continuation is stated.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes implementation to government ministries and courts, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["No evidence measures actual use, maintenance or geographic equity."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":66,"end_unit":67,"fact_summary":"The President launched a 2018 National Academy of Information Technology for Persons with Disabilities, intended to build ICT capacity and develop assistive technology; the source also reports criminal penalties for abuse, forced sterilization and harmful treatment.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.7","6B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The academy and cited legal provisions predate 2023; later outcomes are not reported.","ruler_attribution":"The academy launch is expressly attributed to the President; criminal-law provisions are attributed to the state legislature and courts.","limitations":["Formal penalties do not demonstrate consistent enforcement or reduced abuse."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":67,"end_unit":69,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported a national crisis and disaster-management package including evacuation plans, disability components in crisis strategies, field exercises, rehabilitation and financial assistance after disasters, and coordination between disability and women's councils.","question_ids":["3B.9","6B.6","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Preparedness measures are historical; no 2023 crisis test or outcome is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the measures to cabinet and ministries, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The document does not provide evidence of implementation during a specific 2023 emergency."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":70,"end_unit":71,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported constitutional and statutory guarantees of equality, legal aid, fee exemptions and accessible proceedings for persons with disabilities, including court-provided interpreters and experts; an administrative court ordered social-security and stipend increases in individual cases.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","4B.7","6B.2","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Legal guarantees and judicial remedies predate 2023; current compliance is not established.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes these safeguards and remedies to laws, courts and ministries, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The evidence shows formal rights and selected remedies, not systematic access or compliance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":72,"end_unit":73,"fact_summary":"Egypt's Constitution and criminal law formally protect personal freedom, privacy and expression, but criminalize unauthorized recording and publication, with imprisonment and confiscation provisions; public officials abusing office in such acts face imprisonment.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Formal legal framework predates 2023; application during 2023 is not shown.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the rules to the Constitution and criminal legislation, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The provisions combine privacy protections with restrictions that may constrain journalism and scrutiny; enforcement evidence is absent."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":74,"end_unit":77,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported constitutional and statutory prohibitions on torture, cruel treatment, arbitrary detention and abuse, ratification of relevant international conventions, prison accessibility and health measures, and prosecutorial and Interior Ministry monitoring with criminal or disciplinary referrals for alleged excessive force, torture and harsh treatment.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.9","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Legal and institutional claims are historical and not specific to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source describes state and prosecutorial institutions; it does not establish el-Sisi's personal supervision or the results of referrals.","limitations":["The account is government-reported and supplies no aggregate investigation, conviction or remedy data."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":78,"end_unit":81,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported criminalization of violence, trafficking, sexual exploitation, forced abortion and abuse of children with disabilities; human-rights sections in ministries and the prosecution service, sign-language training, and an anti-bullying and anti-violence campaign were also reported.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.7","3B.9","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Most measures predate 2023; no 2023 enforcement or outcome data is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the measures to legislation, ministries, prosecutors and councils, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["Formal criminalization and campaigns do not establish reduced violence or consistent accountability."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":82,"end_unit":85,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported disability-related social-housing allocations of at least 5 percent, monthly assistance and pension-combination rights, transport accessibility and 50-percent fare reductions, and administrative-court rulings approving specially equipped vehicles for persons with disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.7","6B.8","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Policies and rulings are historical; their incidence and continuation in 2023 are not established.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the measures to ministries, laws and courts, not directly to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not report uptake, enforcement rates or exclusion in practice."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is an Egyptian government response focused primarily on disability rights and related legal and social measures, with most evidence predating 2023.","It provides little or no evidence relevant to nuclear risk, international peace, macroeconomic performance or personal integrity beyond general institutional rules.","Government-reported measures are not independently verified in the supplied units; formal law and programme descriptions should not be treated as proof of nationwide implementation or outcomes in 2023."]}
